description: The chart represents the distribution of topics in a dataset, comparing the proportions of different categories. The pie chart is divided into five slices, representing the topics "Moive", "Person", "Book", "Sport", and an unspecified category associated with a grey color in the legend, although the grey slice is not visible in the chart. The slices are labeled with their corresponding topics and percentage values. The "Moive" category is represented by a light blue slice and accounts for approximately 41.2% of the total, while "Person" is represented by a pink slice and makes up around 30.5%. The "Book" category is depicted in yellow and constitutes about 9.1%, and "Sport" is shown in purple, making up around 4.3%. The remaining slice, colored green, represents an unspecified or potentially mislabeled category "Moive" (potentially meant to be "Movie") in the legend but is labeled as 14.9% in the chart. A legend is provided in the center of the chart, and the percentage labels are displayed inside the slices. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, starting with "Moive" at the top, and appear to be ordered by their size, with the largest slice first.
